answer: Latency Prism Split. Route each new agent's first N actions through a prism of parallel verification channels and measure inter-arrival timing; genuine agents produce a decaying spiral of response delays as trust accrues. Identities whose timing histograms do not match this decay are held at low privilege. Each retained identity becomes a relic carrying accumulated delay history, so an attacker must sustain realistic timing across many identities for weeks, paying compute and coordination cost per identity that grows with N.
